name: MCB 3844W
title: Microbiology and the Media
description: Analysis and comparison of how contemporary microbiological topics such as food-borne diseases and influenza outbreaks are represented in the scientific literature and in popular media.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; at least two MCB courses at the 2000 level or above; open only to Molecular and Cell Biology and Biological Sciences majors; others by permission.
